name: Platform Experience & Self-Service Portal
description: One front door: dashboard, catalog, requests, approvals, search, assistant.

capabilities.name: Unified dashboard
capabilities.summary: Overview reads live KPIs, request status, health and notifications from the API.

capabilities.name: Service catalog
capabilities.summary: Catalog items with input schemas, risk tier and approval rules; admins toggle items in Configure.

capabilities.name: Self-service launch (EC2, DynamoDB, S3 website and more)
capabilities.summary: Guided wizard; every launch becomes a reviewed Terraform/Atmos change in M03.

capabilities.name: Request management
capabilities.summary: Create, view, cancel requests; per-user visibility.

capabilities.name: Approval center
capabilities.summary: Approve or reject requests and infrastructure changes; requesters cannot approve their own.

capabilities.name: AI assistant
capabilities.summary: Keyword help API (/api/assistant). No LLM or UI yet; the AI platform is M09.
